title: Claude Headless API
description: Requests, Claude runs, queueing, tokens, cost, logs and traces exported by Claude Headless API over OpenTelemetry.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests that asked Claude for something (chat completions, session turns, dashboard chat), including rejected ones, over the dashboard's time range. Exact counts from the request log.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users who sent at least one request in the time range (admins using the dashboard chat count too).

panels.title: Active API tokens
panels.description: Distinct API tokens used in the time range. Dashboard-chat requests have no token.

panels.title: Conversations
panels.description: Distinct sessions (API or dashboard chat) that had at least one turn in the time range.

panels.title: Tokens (in + out)
panels.description: Uncached input plus output tokens of successful requests. Cache reads are left out (see Usage and cost below).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | status = "ok" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | status = "ok" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range]))

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: Cost reported by Claude Code. With a subscription token this is an API-price estimate, not a bill.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | status = "ok" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Requests over time
panels.description: chat.completions and sessions.messages come from the API; dashboard.chat from the admin chat.

panels.title: Requests by user
panels.description: Top 10 users by number of requests in the time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user) (count_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | user != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Tokens by user (in + out)
panels.description: Top 10 users by uncached input plus output tokens.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user) (sum_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | status = "ok" | user != "" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + on (user) sum by (user) (sum_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | status = "ok" | user != "" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range])))

panels.title: Cost by user
panels.description: Top 10 users by reported cost.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user) (sum_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | status = "ok" | user != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.title: Models
panels.description: Successful requests per model.

panels.title: Effort
panels.description: Successful requests per effort level.

panels.title: API vs dashboard chat
panels.description: Where requests came from.

targets.expr: sum by (source) (count_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | label_format source=`{{ if eq .endpoint "dashboard.chat" }}dashboard chat{{ else }}API{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Stateless vs sessions
panels.description: Stateless completions vs turns in a server-side session.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({service_name="$job"} | endpoint != "" | model =~ "$model" | status = "ok" | label_format kind=`{{ if .chat_session_id }}session turn{{ else }}stateless{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: API and dashboard-chat requests that reached the app (including rejected ones).

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests that were rejected (4xx) or failed (5xx).

panels.title: Claude run p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the Claude CLI run time, excluding time queued.

panels.title: Running / queued
panels.description: Claude processes running now, and requests waiting for a free slot.

panels.title: Runs by outcome
panels.description: Claude CLI runs per second: ok, error (upstream failure), timeout, cancelled.

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: How long the Claude CLI process ran (queue time excluded).

panels.title: Concurrency
panels.description: Running Claude processes against the configured limit (Settings → Max concurrent runs), and the queue behind it.

panels.title: Queue wait
panels.description: Time requests waited for a free Claude slot. Rising values mean the concurrency limit is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Runs by session mode
panels.description: stateless = one-off completion; new = first turn of a session; resume = later session turns.

panels.title: Tokens per minute
panels.description: Tokens reported by Claude Code, by type. Input includes Claude Code's own context.

panels.title: Cost per hour
panels.description: Spend rate by model, extrapolated to an hour.

panels.title: Prompt cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of input tokens served from Claude's prompt cache. Sessions usually raise it.

panels.title: Rejected and failed requests by code
panels.description: model_not_found, rate_limit_exceeded, upstream_error, timeout, … (see the API docs' Error schema).

panels.title: HTTP latency p95 by route
panels.description: End-to-end server time per API route, including queueing and the Claude run.

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: SQLAlchemy pool connections by state. 'used' pinned at the pool size means requests are waiting for a connection.

panels.title: Request log (failures)
panels.description: Structured request records whose status isn't ok. Expand a line and use 'View trace' to open it in Tempo.

panels.title: Claude run traces (click a trace ID)
panels.description: Traces containing a Claude run (Tempo search order, not strictly newest first). Open one to see queue wait and process time.
